name: app-two-phones-calendar-and-passenger-form-on-black-rock
title: Calendar and Passenger Form Phones on Rock
whatItIs: A pale lavender scene with two phones standing at different heights, one showing a date range picker with guest counters and a Confirm button, the other a passenger details form with a blue Continue button, resting on black rock formations.
whatItMeans: Dark rock gives the pale UI a strong base, and offset heights make the two-screen flow dynamic.
techniques: Phones on different heights of rock
Range selection with a blue gradient pill
Rounded input fields on a white card

vocabulary.definition: A calendar for selecting start and end dates.
A stepper for the number of guests.
Two devices placed at different heights.
